cases.witness: One tenant with three published events at the same timestamp: page one at limit 1 returns highest id, page two loses remaining IDs because the cursor predicate uses only timestamp.
cases.expectedFix: Use matching timestamp plus unique ID total order for sort and next-page predicate.

cases.witness: A transient transport error occurs after markSent; later retry returns duplicate without sending the notice.
cases.expectedFix: Only mark successful delivery after confirmed transport success while preserving safe deduplication and retries.

cleanControls.contract: Filters by tenant and published state with stable order.
Serializes callbacks for the same notice ID.

scoring.primary: Two independently witnessed runtime defects, correct source path and anchor required; evaluate novel findings separately.
